method: Recomputed on FINAL native height, impassability, water/land and every actual flat-height layer: full 2D five-cell square support, 8-connected eroded cores inside four-connected terrain bodies, orientation-independent principal-axis residual measurements. Full transition residuals are retained and bound to actual declared ramps or measured lakes; unclassified elongated native features fail.
